title: Tech Note: Creating a Basic Store Using 4D Business Kit

historical_commentary.text: 4D Business Kit has been discontinued for many years, making this note's specific HTML-tag-based storefront setup obsolete; anyone building a modern e-commerce storefront today would use current web frameworks or dedicated e-commerce platforms rather than 4DBK.
related_updates: 4D Business Kit has been discontinued; modern e-commerce storefronts are built with current web frameworks or dedicated e-commerce platforms
